idea-plugin.name: Phantom Modal Commit
idea-plugin.description: Brings back the modal commit dialog for Git and Mercurial instead of the Commit tool window: Settings | Advanced Settings | Version Control | Use modal commit interface. On the first start it follows the "Use non-modal commit interface" setting you had. Ported from the IntelliJ Community Modal Commit Interface (Apache 2.0) so it updates without a new Phantom build; turn the bundled Modal Commit Interface off if your Phantom still bundles it.
